title: 第八課：坐火車去臺南
zh1:
如玉：這個週末，我想跟朋友去臺南玩。
明華：怎麼去？
如玉：我想坐火車去。
明華：火車太慢了，要四個多鐘頭，坐高鐵比較快。
如玉：可是聽說高鐵車票非常貴。
明華：高鐵車票有一點貴，但是坐高鐵又快又舒服。
如玉：我不知道在哪裡買票。
明華：在高鐵站、網路上或者是便利商店都可以。
如玉：這麼方便！那我坐高鐵去，謝謝你。
py1:
Rúyù：Zhè ge zhōumò, wǒ xiǎng gēn péngyou qù Táinán wán.
Mínghuá：Zěnme qù?
Rúyù：Wǒ xiǎng zuò huǒchē qù.
Mínghuá：Huǒchē tài màn le, yào sì ge duō zhōngtóu, zuò gāotiě bǐjiào kuài.
Rúyù：Kěshì tīngshuō gāotiě chēpiào fēicháng guì.
Mínghuá：Gāotiě chēpiào yǒu yìdiǎn guì, dànshì zuò gāotiě yòu kuài yòu shūfu.
Rúyù：Wǒ bù zhīdào zài nǎlǐ mǎi piào.
Mínghuá：Zài gāotiězhàn, wǎnglùshàng huòshì biànlì shāngdiàn dōu kěyǐ.
Rúyù：Zhème fāngbiàn! Nà wǒ zuò gāotiě qù, xièxie nǐ.
en1:
Ruyu：I want to go to Tainan with friends this weekend.
Minghua：How are you going?
Ruyu：I would like to go by train.
Minghua：The train is too slow. It takes more than four hours. Taking the High Speed Rail is faster.
Ruyu：But I have heard that High Speed Rail tickets are very expensive.
Minghua：The tickets are a little expensive, but the High Speed Rail is both fast and comfortable.
Ruyu：I do not know where to buy tickets.
Minghua：You can buy them at an HSR station, online, or at a convenience store.
Ruyu：That is so convenient! Then I will go by High Speed Rail. Thank you.
zh2:
如玉：安同，明天我們沒課，你想去哪裡？
安同：我要跟同學去參觀故宮博物院。
如玉：聽說那裡有很多中國古代的東西。
安同：是啊。妳要跟我們去看看嗎？
如玉：好。怎麼去？
安同：我同學騎機車載我。妳可以坐公共汽車去。
如玉：我想坐捷運去。比較快。
安同：不行，到故宮沒有捷運。妳要不要坐計程車去？
如玉：太貴了！我坐公車。騎機車比坐公車快嗎？
安同：差不多。
py2:
Rúyù：Āntóng, míngtiān wǒmen méi kè, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
Āntóng：Wǒ yào gēn tóngxué qù cānguān Gùgōng Bówùyuàn.
Rúyù：Tīngshuō nàlǐ yǒu hěnduō Zhōngguó gǔdài de dōngxi.
Āntóng：Shì a. Nǐ yào gēn wǒmen qù kànkan ma?
Rúyù：Hǎo. Zěnme qù?
Āntóng：Wǒ tóngxué qí jīchē zài wǒ. Nǐ kěyǐ zuò gōnggòng qìchē qù.
Rúyù：Wǒ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù. Bǐjiào kuài.
Āntóng：Bù xíng, dào Gùgōng méiyǒu jiéyùn. Nǐ yào bú yào zuò jìchéngchē qù?
Rúyù：Tài guì le! Wǒ zuò gōngchē. Qí jīchē bǐ zuò gōngchē kuài ma?
Āntóng：Chābuduō.
en2:
Ruyu：Antong, we do not have class tomorrow. Where do you want to go?
Antong：I am going to the National Palace Museum with my classmates.
Ruyu：I have heard that there are many ancient Chinese objects there.
Antong：Yes. Would you like to go with us to take a look?
Ruyu：Okay. How are we going?
Antong：My classmate is giving me a ride on his scooter. You can take the bus.
Ruyu：I want to take the MRT. It is faster.
Antong：That will not work. There is no MRT to the Palace Museum. Would you like to take a taxi?
Ruyu：Too expensive! I will take the bus. Is riding a scooter faster than taking the bus?
Antong：About the same.

act:
I. Making Arrangements
【目標 Goal】Plan and discuss leisure activities.
【做法 Task】Plan a weekend with family or friends. Fill in time, transportation, destination, and activity, then share with classmates.
【例】今天下午我要跟媽媽坐公車到學校附近去吃越南菜。

II. Tell Us What You Think
【目標 Goal】Explain at least two reasons for liking or disliking something.
【做法 Task】Discuss why you take the HSR, buy a phone, avoid a noodle shop, or like a movie.
【例】A：為什麼你喜歡喝烏龍茶？
B：烏龍茶又好喝又便宜，所以我喜歡。

III. Which Is Better?
【目標 Goal】Use 比 or 比較 to express a simple preference.
【做法 Task】Discuss possible weekend activities, decide on a plan, and report why the selected activity is better.
【例】去 KTV 比看電影有意思。坐捷運比較快。

IV. How Do You Plan on Getting There?
【目標 Goal】Use transportation vocabulary to discuss reaching a destination.
【做法 Task】Your friend or family will visit Taiwan. Explain how you plan to take them to Yangmingshan: by bus, MRT, taxi, or scooter.
【例】我想先坐捷運，再坐公車去陽明山。
cult:
伴手禮文化 Souvenirs
在華人傳統文化與禮儀中，人們旅行、出差或返鄉時，習慣購買當地特產作為「伴手禮／手信」，送給親友或同事。臺灣常見的伴手禮包括阿里山茶葉、鳳梨酥、太陽餅、花蓮大理石、臺灣珊瑚，以及印有臺灣景點、臺北 101 或臺灣地圖的 T-shirt 和鑰匙圈。

臺北 YouBike 系統 YouBike in Taipei
YouBike（微笑單車）是臺北市便利的公共自行車租賃系統，全天候 24 小時營運，採數位化、無人化管理。它提供綠色、經濟且方便的「最後一哩路」接駁服務，鼓勵民眾少開車、少騎機車，多使用大眾運輸工具。

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 跟 + Person + VP

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: The preposition 跟 introduces a person who performs an action or activity together with the subject.
blocks.ex:
我常跟哥哥去看棒球比賽。
I often watch baseball games with my brother.
我週末要跟同學去參觀故宮。
I am visiting the Palace Museum with classmates this weekend.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: The 跟 + person phrase must precede the main verb phrase. It commonly occurs with 一起 before the main verb.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Place the negative marker before 跟.
blocks.ex:
我今天不跟同學去上書法課。
I am not going to calligraphy class with my classmate today.
他不跟我一起去 KTV 唱歌。
He is not going to KTV with me.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use 誰, 嗎, or 跟不跟 to ask companionship questions.
blocks.ex:
你常跟誰去看電影？
Who do you often go to the movies with?
你跟不跟我去圖書館看書？
Will you go to the library with me?

gps.title: II. Asking How with 怎麼 zěnme

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 怎麼 + V

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 怎麼 is an interrogative adverb asking how an action is performed.
blocks.ex:
你們怎麼去？
How are you going?
這個菜怎麼做？
How is this dish made?
這支新手機怎麼上網？
How does this new phone access the internet?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 怎麼 is an adverb followed by a verb and asks about method. 怎麼樣 is a state verb asking for an evaluation or opinion.
blocks.ex:
這個菜怎麼做？
How is this dish made?
這個菜怎麼樣？
What do you think of this dish?

gps.title: III. Implicit Comparison with 比較 bǐjiào

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 比較 + Predicate

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 比較 expresses an implicit comparison when the comparison standard is omitted but recoverable from context.
blocks.ex:
今天比較熱。
Today is relatively hot.
越南餐廳很遠。坐捷運比較快。
The Vietnamese restaurant is far; taking the MRT is faster.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: 比較 cannot be directly negated. Place 不 or 沒有 before the main verb or state verb.
blocks.ex:
昨天比較不熱。
Yesterday was relatively less hot.
我最近比較沒有空。
I have had relatively less free time lately.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: 比較 can occur in 嗎 or choice questions when the relevant alternatives are available from context.
blocks.ex:
咖啡和茶，你比較喜歡喝咖啡嗎？
Between coffee and tea, do you prefer coffee?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: In Taiwan, 比較 nearly always has a comparative meaning. In mainland China it may sometimes mean “rather” without an explicit comparison.

gps.title: IV. Both A and B 又…又…

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 又 + Predicate + 又 + Predicate

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 又…又… indicates that the same subject simultaneously has two states, circumstances, or actions.
blocks.ex:
這家餐廳的菜又便宜又好吃，所以我們常來吃。
The food is both cheap and delicious, so we often eat here.
坐高鐵又快又舒服，可是有一點貴。
The HSR is both fast and comfortable, but a little expensive.

blocks.label: 結構
blocks.text: The predicates after the two instances of 又 are parallel and describe the same topic. They may be state verbs or verb phrases.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Place 不 or 不能 after each 又 to negate both parallel predicates.
blocks.ex:
老闆今天做的臭豆腐又不臭又不辣。
The stinky tofu is neither smelly nor spicy.
我的舊手機又不能照相又不能上網。
My old phone can neither take pictures nor go online.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: A + 比 + B + Vs

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 比 explicitly compares the degree of a property between two noun phrases or pronouns.
blocks.ex:
山上的風景比這裡漂亮。
The mountain scenery is prettier than here.
坐捷運比坐火車快。
Taking the MRT is faster than taking the train.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: Explicit comparisons may be negated with 不 or 不是.
blocks.ex:
在家上網不比在學校快。
Going online at home is not faster than at school.
我的車不比他的車貴。
My vehicle is not more expensive than his.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Use 嗎 to ask whether A exceeds B in a stated quality.
blocks.ex:
他們學校比你們學校遠嗎？
Is their school farther than yours?

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: In A 比 B + Vs, the state verb cannot be preceded by degree adverbs such as 很, 真, or 非常.

qs.instruction: Choose 怎麼 or 怎麼樣.

qs.prompt:
A：這家咖啡店的咖啡怎麼樣？
B：＿＿。

A：你覺得這個電影怎麼樣？
B：＿＿。

A：我們週末去運動還是在家看書？
B：我們去 KTV 唱歌。（不想運動、不想看書）
answer: 我又不想運動又不想看書。

qs.prompt:
A：你為什麼不買這種手機？（不好看、不能上網）
B：＿＿。
A：週末你想去看電影還是去 KTV 唱歌？為什麼？
answer: 我想去 KTV 唱歌。我覺得去 KTV 唱歌比看電影有意思。

qs.prompt: A：坐公車便宜還是坐計程車便宜？
answer: 坐公車比坐計程車便宜。
